topicTitle: Advanced Train Problems — Two Moving Trains

questions.question: Two trains of 120 m and 90 m run in opposite directions at 72 and 54 km/h. They cross in (seconds)
A 150 m train at 72 km/h overtakes a 100 m train at 54 km/h. The time is (seconds)
A train 180 m long passes a pole in 18 s. Its speed in km/h is
A 200 m train at 20 m/s crosses a 300 m bridge in (seconds)
A 100 m train at 54 km/h passes a man walking in the opposite direction at 6 km/h in (seconds)
Two equal trains of 100 m each cross in 10 s moving oppositely at equal speeds. Each speed is (m/s)
questions.explanation: Relative speed = 200/10 = 20 m/s, so each is 10.

questions.question: A train takes 18 s to pass a pole and 27 s to pass a 90 m platform. Its length is (metres)
A train leaves X at 60 km/h. One hour later another leaves Y (300 km away) at 40 km/h towards X. They meet at a distance from X of (km)
questions.explanation: 60 km in the first hour; the rest 240 closes at 100 km/h in 2.4 h; first train travels 3.4 h × 60 = 204.

questions.question: Two trains run at 60 and 90 km/h in the same direction and cross in 30 s. The sum of their lengths is (metres)
A 150 m train at 36 km/h takes 40 s to cross a bridge. The bridge is (metres)
A train crosses a 120 m platform in 15 s and a 180 m platform in 20 s. Its length is (metres)
Two trains of lengths 200 m and 300 m start from opposite ends and cross in 10 s. If the first goes at 20 m/s, the second goes at (m/s)
A train 100 m long passes a man running in the same direction at 6 km/h in 10 s. The speed of the train is (km/h)
questions.explanation: Relative speed 10 m/s = 36 km/h; train = 42 km/h.

questions.question: A train at 54 km/h crosses a platform in 30 s and a man on the platform in 18 s. The length of the platform is (metres)
Trains A and B start together from two stations 300 km apart towards each other. After meeting, A takes 4 h and B takes 9 h to reach the opposite stations. The ratio of speeds A : B is
A train 300 m long passes a platform in 36 s and a pole in 18 s. The length of the platform is (metres)
questions.explanation: Speed = 300/18 = 50/3 m/s; in 36 s it covers 600 m; platform = 300.

questions.question: Two trains of lengths 150 m and 100 m run in opposite directions on parallel tracks. A man in the shorter train notices the longer train pass him in 6 s. The speed of the longer train relative to the man is (m/s)
A train travelling at 72 km/h passes a 250 m platform in 20 s. Its length is (metres)
A goods train leaves a station at 6 a.m. at 40 km/h. An express leaves the same station at 7 a.m. at 60 km/h on the same track. The express catches the goods train at (a.m.)
questions.explanation: Head start 40 km. Gain 20 km/h: 2 h after 7 a.m., i.e. 9 a.m.
